title: NCP-ArchPreview Technical Report: Moving towards Latent Space Language Models through Next Concept Prediction
task: Latent-space language modeling with next-concept prediction
key_results: 8.9B model achieves OLMo-3-7B loss using 51.3% of training tokens; outperforms OLMo-3-7B by 2.45 points downstream with 5.99-point gain on GSM8K
comments: Introduces explicit concept-level objectives alongside token prediction, showing that structured latent spaces can improve sample efficiency, though scalability beyond 8.9B remains untested.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Latent space architecture and NCP objective independently improve performance
hypotheses.result: Controlled experiments isolate clear progression of gains from both components

title: SenseNova-U1.5: Towards Native Unified Visual Intelligence
task: Native unified multimodal understanding and visual content generation
key_results: 8B-MoT model improves image fidelity, text rendering, and editing across extensive benchmarks; handles up to 4K native resolution with spatially coherent patch reconstruction
comments: Encoder-free, VAE-free architecture is novel but evaluation metrics and quantitative comparisons against baselines are not detailed in abstract.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Native unified modelling without separate encoders/VAEs enables end-to-end visual understanding and generation
hypotheses.result: System demonstrates effective generalization to long, complex, structured visual instructions despite limited structured-format training data

title: SpatialBlock: Enhancing Spatial Intelligence in LVLMs via Synthetic Block-Stacking Problem
task: Evaluating and improving 3D spatial reasoning in Video-LVLMs
key_results: SpatialBlock-15k synthetic dataset (15K block-stacking problems) helps LVLMs outperform baselines and generalize to real-world spatial tasks; identifies Alignment as primary bottleneck
comments: Synthetic data approach avoids expensive dense geometric annotation, but transfer from block-stacking to real-world spatial tasks may be limited by domain gap.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Block-stacking tasks develop foundational spatial skills transferable to real scenes
hypotheses.result: Models trained on SpatialBlock-15k generalize to real-world spatial question answering despite synthetic training data

hypotheses.hypothesis: Temporal alignment is the primary bottleneck in spatial reasoning
hypotheses.result: Error analysis shows models struggle with when events occur, despite recognizing plausible content and local progression

title: EvoSafeHarness: Evolving Model- and Domain-Specific Harnesses for Securing Agents
task: Evolving model-specific safety harnesses for LLM agents
key_results: Reduces attack success rate from 45.6% to 10.0% on DecodingTrust-Agent with 3.3-point utility cost; achieves 82.8% utility at 0.0% ASR on AgentDojo, transfers to unseen AgentDyn suites
comments: Promising safety-utility frontier but relies on evolutionary search which may not scale to very large policy spaces; adaptive attacks remain a concern.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Domain semantics determine which safety relations must be enforced; model behavior determines where and how
hypotheses.result: Analysis confirms deployment-dependent protection varies across models and domains, fixed expert harnesses suboptimal

title: Mi-Ripple: Restoring Images Degraded by Iterative AI Editing
task: Restoring images degraded by iterative AI editing
key_results: Grid artifacts reduced with 0.08–0.44 CIELAB lightness residual; paired regeneration reduces debris density by 45%
comments: Focuses on post-processing restoration rather than preventing artifacts at generation time; effectiveness depends on spectral isolation of periodic patterns.

title: X-AuT: Progressive Audio-Encoder Compression for Speech LLMs with Cross-Scale Distillation
task: Progressive audio-encoder compression for speech LLMs
key_results: Compressing from 18 to 16 layers reduces error from 5.61% to 5.27%; 14-layer model reaches 5.75% with 20.7% fewer parameters; cross-scale distillation outperforms self-distillation (5.55% vs 8.45%)
comments: Achieves significant compression but benefits vary across benchmarks; progressive pruning strategy is sound but requires careful layer selection heuristics.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Progressive layer selection and cross-scale distillation preserve decoder compatibility better than direct pruning
hypotheses.result: Progressive 18→14 pruning outperforms direct pruning (5.75% vs 6.73%)

title: TempCloze: Can Video-LLMs Identify the Missing Middle?
task: Evaluating temporal reasoning in Video-LLMs via visual cloze task
key_results: 1,521-video benchmark reveals Alignment as primary bottleneck; error analysis on TempCloze-Mixed/Hard shows sensitivity to candidate order, context direction, frame density, and scaling
comments: Well-designed benchmark reduces linguistic shortcuts but cloze format may not capture all temporal reasoning failures; limited to 10 proprietary and 21 open-source models.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Video-LLMs struggle with temporal alignment despite semantic and progression understanding
hypotheses.result: Error patterns show models recognize plausible content and local progression but fail to align when events occur

title: Memory as Plans: World-Action Modeling with Memory-Grounded Planning
task: Long-horizon robotic manipulation with memory-grounded planning
key_results: 83.3% success on RMBench, 78.0% on real-robot tasks with constant executor inference latency as history grows
comments: Clever decomposition of memory into episodic segments avoids context length explosion, but real-robot results are limited; segment-level granularity may miss fine-grained task structure.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Representing memory as segment records reduces context burden while maintaining long-horizon coherence
hypotheses.result: Executor maintains fixed context length while supporting arbitrarily long task histories through plan-based segmentation

title: Recursive Code World Models: Building Complex Worlds through Recursive Scene Programs
task: Reconstructing complex 3D worlds from single images as executable code
key_results: Recursive Code World Models outperform prior code-based methods; ablations show benefits of recursive construction and deeper calls for finer-scale refinement
comments: Global-local-global recursion is intuitive but computational cost and convergence properties are not discussed; limited to single-image reconstruction.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Recursive scene programs with global-local-global refinement better capture complex spatial relationships than flat reconstruction
hypotheses.result: Recursion with parent revisitation improves fine-scale structure while preserving scene-wide geometry

title: FreeFlow: A Bias-free Hierarchical Transformer for Optical Flow Estimation
task: Optical flow estimation without task-specific inductive biases
key_results: State-of-the-art on Sintel (0.68/1.48 EPE), KITTI-2015 (3.23 Fl-all), Spring (3.192 1px); hierarchical transformer with three attention variants outperforms bias-heavy methods
comments: Demonstrates that generic transformer architectures can match or exceed task-specific designs; scalability with model capacity is valuable but inference cost comparisons with prior methods absent.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Generic transformer attention (window, shifted-window, global) without correlation volumes or warping can achieve state-of-the-art optical flow
hypotheses.result: FreeFlow matches or exceeds specialized methods on major benchmarks with fewer inductive biases

title: CARDEA: Auditable Reasoning Grounded in Spatial Evidence for End-to-End Coronary Angiography Interpretation
task: Auditable end-to-end coronary angiography interpretation with spatial evidence
key_results: Dominance classification: 0.91 accuracy [0.86-0.95] under domain shift; complexity assessment: 0.90 [0.82-0.97] vs cardiologists; zero-shot report macro-F₁ 0.686 [0.664-0.707] after RLVR vs 0.513 baseline
comments: RLVR with verifiable rewards enables zero-shot report generation not achieved by supervised imitation; clinical adoption requires prospective validation despite technical soundness.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards on closed-ended tasks transfers to open-ended report generation
hypotheses.result: RLVR with CoB reward improves zero-shot macro-F₁ from 0.513 to 0.686, surpassing supervised baseline

title: World in World: Explore the World with World Models
task: Training-free camera-controlled video rerendering and long-horizon revisiting
key_results: Supports camera-controlled rerendering, long-horizon revisiting, and human-motion transfer with single frozen video model; no quantitative metrics reported
comments: Novel inference-time interface uses self-attention of frozen model but lacks rigorous perceptual quality evaluation; comparison to task-specific baselines missing.

model_io.model: World in World (inference interface for frozen causal video model)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Evidence-wise attention CFG can independently regulate auxiliary channels without retraining
hypotheses.result: Shared frozen interface supports multiple control modalities (camera, revisiting, motion transfer)

title: Negative Self-Distillation: Learning to Reason by Avoiding Flaws
task: LLM self-improvement via diverging from self-generated flawed reasoning
key_results: Negative Self-Distillation outperforms On-Policy Self-Distillation and label-free RL baselines on complex reasoning; dynamic gating isolates reasoning-critical tokens
comments: Clever insight that OPSD suppresses uncertainty; NSD's gate mechanism requires problem-specific tuning of what constitutes 'reasoning-critical' tokens.

hypotheses.hypothesis: OPSD degrades reasoning by suppressing uncertainty and penalizing self-correction
hypotheses.result: NSD consistently outperforms OPSD on complex reasoning tasks

hypotheses.hypothesis: Dynamic gating can isolate reasoning-critical tokens without catastrophic degradation of language priors
hypotheses.result: Gradient updates target behavioral flaws while preserving linguistic capabilities

title: DRG-MAPPO: Hierarchical Dynamic Role-Graph Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning for Cooperative Air Combat
task: Hierarchical MARL for cooperative air combat with dynamic role assignment
key_results: 87% win rate in cooperative air combat; DRG-MAPPO outperforms flat MARL by integrating graph-based relational modeling with dynamic role assignment
comments: Hierarchical design with explicit roles improves interpretability and tactical coordination, but scalability to larger numbers of agents and real-world applicability unclear.

model_io.model: DRG-MAPPO (graph attention + role assignment + action policy)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Graph-based relational modeling with dynamic role assignment improves tactical coordination in MARL
hypotheses.result: Achieves 87% win rate by balancing relational modeling, interpretability, and optimization stability

title: UniH^3: Unifying Hierarchical Homogeneity and Heterogeneity for All-in-One Medical Image Restoration
task: All-in-one medical image restoration across modalities and degradation types
key_results: State-of-the-art on MedIR-2D-500K and MedIR-3D-3K benchmarks; Hierarchical Homogeneity Memory retrieves shared anatomical priors; Hierarchical Heterogeneity Balancer mitigates inter/intra-task conflicts
comments: Leveraging anatomical homogeneity is intuitive for medical imaging but may not transfer to non-medical visual restoration; evaluation on single cross-domain dataset would strengthen claims.

model_io.model: UniH3 (H2M memory module + HGA attention + H2B optimizer)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Exploiting intra/inter-task homogeneity alongside heterogeneity modeling improves all-in-one restoration
hypotheses.result: State-of-the-art on benchmarks by distilling and retrieving shared anatomical priors

title: Generative Late-Interaction Embeddings For Visual Document Retrieval
task: Storage-efficient visual document retrieval via generative late-interaction embeddings
key_results: At 4 vectors per page, retains 80% of uncompressed nDCG@5 vs 70% for best prior method; 415K-parameter decoder fitted in <3 GPU-minutes on 1000 pages
comments: Novel insight about manifold geometry (dim 5-6) enabling regeneration from few vectors; lightweight training but evaluation limited to ViDoRe benchmarks.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Late-interaction embedding vectors lie on unit sphere with low intrinsic dimensionality enabling regeneration
hypotheses.result: Full embedding sets can be regenerated from k << N learned vectors; normalized centroids prevent systematic score underestimation

title: MetroLLM-Bench: Evaluating Language Models as Transit Kiosk Runtimes
task: Evaluating LLMs as policy layers for transit kiosk systems
key_results: 4B Qwen 3.5 PEFT student exceeds GPT-5.6 on Tier 1 (91.3 vs 90.6) with 2.6GB footprint; PEFT gain decreases with model size (+7.03 at 2B, -0.91 at 27B)
comments: Well-designed benchmark with 955 cases and stratified splits; shows smaller models can outperform larger ones with targeted training, but survey limited to 26 models.

hypotheses.hypothesis: PEFT training benefit decreases with model size due to baseline capability ceiling
hypotheses.result: PEFT gain ranges from +7.03 points at 2B to -0.91 at 27B across four Qwen sizes

title: An Open Recipe for IMO Gold: Training Nemotron for Olympiad Mathematics
task: Post-training and test-time inference for olympiad mathematics
key_results: Scored 30/42 at IMO 2026 (gold-medal threshold); releases two post-trained Nemotron checkpoints, training data, code, 200-problem benchmark (Nemotron-IMO-Bench)
comments: Achieves impressive IMO result using only natural language (no formal prover); success likely depends on Nemotron's pre-training scale and may not generalize to smaller models.

model_io.model: Nemotron 3 Ultra (SFT + RL specialists) + iterative search

hypotheses.hypothesis: Iterative generation, verification, and refinement via natural language improves olympiad performance without formal tools
hypotheses.result: System reaches gold-medal threshold (30/42) using only LLM checkpoints and inference-time search

title: HyQuant: Hybrid-Precision Quantization for LLM Attention
task: Hybrid-precision quantization for LLM attention modules
key_results: Maintains near-lossless accuracy with extremely simple design; retains vertical-line tokens and local windows in high precision while quantizing remaining context
comments: Addresses real problem of attention quantization but lacks detailed benchmarks and bit-width comparisons; 'vertical-line tokens' concept may be task/architecture specific.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Selective retention of accuracy-critical attention regions in high precision reduces quantization error
hypotheses.result: Hybrid quantization maintains accuracy across tasks while improving efficiency; KV-cache compression fuses with attention for memory efficiency

title: A cryptic symmetry switch allosterically controls how the PF4 self-protein turns into a pathogenic antigen
task: Elucidate the molecular basis of PF4 tetramer asymmetry and its role in triggering autoimmune responses
key_results: Cryptic conformational switches control PF4 asymmetry; mutations stabilizing symmetric tetramers markedly reduced HIT antibody affinity; symmetric state is non-immunogenic
comments: This work elegantly decouples electrostatic from conformational determinants of asymmetry and offers a novel immunomodulatory strategy by stabilizing benign conformational states rather than global immunosuppression.

model_io.model: PF4 tetramer (dimer-of-dimers) with cryptic symmetry switches

hypotheses.hypothesis: Electrostatics alone drive PF4 asymmetry
hypotheses.result: Rejected; cryptic conformational switches are primary determinants, not electrostatic forces

hypotheses.hypothesis: Stabilizing symmetric PF4 conformers reduces autoimmune epitope recognition
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; symmetric tetramers show markedly reduced HIT antibody affinity

title: Inspiratory temporal patterning and mechanical architecture shape regional energy distribution in a multicompartment lung model
task: Determine whether global mechanical power uniquely predicts regional energy distribution in heterogeneous lungs
key_results: Regional energy allocation strongly depended on mechanical architecture (compliance-dominant vs resistance-dominant vs mixed); identical global mechanical power produced substantially different regional energy concentration and compartment energy share across architectures
comments: The finding that global power metrics fail to capture regional energetic exposure has important implications for clinical ventilation strategies, suggesting that inspiratory timing must be tailored to underlying lung mechanics rather than applied universally.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Global inspiratory mechanical power uniquely determines regional energy distribution
hypotheses.result: Rejected; same global power routed energy differently across regions depending on mechanical architecture and temporal parameters

hypotheses.hypothesis: Longer inspiration time affects different mechanical phenotypes similarly
hypotheses.result: Contradicted; compliance-dominant increased energy inequality, resistance-dominant decreased it, mixed showed smaller decrease

title: Propionyl-CoA catabolism is a metabolic gatekeeper for fatty acid oxidation in pancreatic cancer
task: Elucidate metabolic regulation of fatty acid oxidation dependency in pancreatic cancer
key_results: PDAC upregulates PCC to accelerate propionyl-CoA catabolism; elevated propionyl-CoA causes ACAA2 propionylation at K137, blocking FAO; high PCCA expression associated with decreased lipid accumulation and etomoxir sensitivity
comments: The identification of the PCC-ACAA2 axis as a metabolic vulnerability is therapeutically promising, though the dependency on propionyl-CoA accumulation toxicity differs from canonical FAO regulation.

model_io.model: PDAC cells and KPC mouse tumors

hypotheses.hypothesis: PCC accelerates propionyl-CoA catabolism to prevent toxic accumulation in PDAC
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; PCC essential for growth by preventing propionyl-CoA toxicity, not via TCA cycle fueling

hypotheses.hypothesis: Elevated propionyl-CoA inactivates ACAA2 and blocks FAO
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; propionylation at K137 inactivates ACAA2, reducing FAO flux required for proliferation

title: CircRHBDD1(4,5) drives malignant progression of oral squamous cell carcinoma by enhancing DKK1 mRNA stability through facilitating m6A-dependent IGF2BP2 binding
task: Determine circRHBDD1(4,5)-mediated regulation of DKK1 mRNA stability in oral squamous cell carcinoma
key_results: circRHBDD1(4,5) upregulated in OSCC and promotes proliferation, invasion, metastasis; functions as molecular scaffold bringing IGF2BP2 and DKK1 mRNA into proximity via m⁶A-WTAP interaction; enhanced DKK1 stability activates PI3K-AKT signaling
comments: The circRNA scaffolding mechanism is elegant and provides a novel paradigm for circRNA function beyond simple miRNA sponges, though functional validation of the spatial proximity model requires advanced imaging approaches.

model_io.model: OSCC cell lines and patient tissues

hypotheses.hypothesis: circRHBDD1(4,5) scaffolds IGF2BP2 and DKK1 mRNA to enhance m⁶A-dependent recognition
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; circRNA brings proteins into proximity, facilitating WTAP-mediated m⁶A interaction with IGF2BP2

hypotheses.hypothesis: Enhanced DKK1 mRNA stability drives OSCC malignant progression via PI3K-AKT
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; elevated DKK1 expression activates PI3K-AKT signaling in OSCC cells

title: Spatial control of parathyroid hormone receptor-1 signaling dictates ligand-specific biological outcomes
task: Determine compartmentalized PTH1R signaling mechanisms encoding ligand-specific skeletal and mineral homeostasis outcomes
key_results: β-arrestins dampen PTHrP-driven Gαs signaling at plasma membrane but promote PTH-induced endosomal PTH1R signaling; Eiken syndrome R485X-PTH1R (β-arrestin docking-deficient) shows delayed bone mineralization (enhanced PTHrP phenotype) and hypocalcemia/elevated PTH (impaired PTH phenotype); R485X knock-in mice recapitulate paradoxical Eiken phenotype
comments: The elegant resolution of the Eiken syndrome paradox through β-arrestin-mediated compartmentalization provides mechanistic insight into how subcellular localization encodes signaling specificity, with implications for understanding GPCR biology more broadly.

hypotheses.hypothesis: β-arrestins impose bimodal compartment-specific modulation of PTH1R signaling
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; β-arrestins dampen plasma membrane PTHrP signaling but promote endosomal PTH signaling

hypotheses.hypothesis: Eiken syndrome R485X-PTH1R phenotype results from impaired PTH endosomal signaling and enhanced plasma membrane PTHrP signaling
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; knock-in mice exhibit delayed mineralization and hypocalcemia/elevated PTH consistent with mechanistic prediction

title: Malic enzyme 1 senses L-lactate to determine tumor heterogeneity
task: Elucidate L-lactate sensing mechanism regulating tumor heterogeneity and metabolic adaptation
key_results: ME1 directly binds L-lactate at R155, promoting nuclear translocation via reduced K362 acetylation and KPNA4-mediated import; nuclear ME1 enhances metastasis and EMT via HDGF interaction; lactate promotes ME1-LDHB complex assembly enhancing OXPHOS and ATP production under nutrient stress; ME1R155A mutation abolishes protumorigenic effects in vivo
comments: The dual roles of ME1 as both a lactate sensor and metabolic regulator provide elegant mechanistic insight into lactate-driven tumor plasticity, though the temporal dynamics of nuclear ME1 accumulation and metabolic switching deserve clarification.

model_io.model: Tumor cells under nutrient-replete and nutrient-deficient conditions

hypotheses.hypothesis: Direct L-lactate binding at ME1-R155 promotes nuclear translocation and metastatic signaling
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; L-lactate binding triggers reduced K362 acetylation and KPNA4-facilitated nuclear import enhancing HDGF interaction

hypotheses.hypothesis: Lactate-promoted ME1-LDHB complex assembly supports OXPHOS-dependent survival under nutrient stress
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; ME1-LDHB assembly enhances OXPHOS and ATP production in nutrient-deficient conditions

title: Insulin-like growth factor receptor signaling in physiology and disease
task: Comprehensive review of IGF signaling pathway in physiology and disease
key_results: IGF pathway regulates cell proliferation, differentiation, redox homeostasis through PI3K-AKT and MAPK/ERK; crosstalk with insulin, EGFR, PDGFR, VEGF, Wnt/β-catenin, JAK-STAT, TGF-β/BMP pathways; implicated in cancer, cardiovascular, neurodegenerative, metabolic, skeletal, autoimmune, and rare genetic disorders; FDA-approved IGF/IGFR antagonists available
comments: This comprehensive review synthesizes extensive literature but lacks quantitative comparative analysis of pathway contributions across diseases; systems-level integration models would strengthen therapeutic prediction.

title: Fibronectin 1 mediated histone lactylation promotes malignant progression of GIST regulated by m6A modification
task: Elucidate FN1-mediated histone lactylation axis driving GIST malignancy and imatinib resistance
key_results: FTO-mediated m⁶A demethylation protects FN1 mRNA from YTHDF3-mediated degradation; elevated FN1 increases H3K18la levels, activating KIT transcription and driving GIST progression; FN1 knockout cells show significant imatinib sensitization in vitro and in vivo
comments: The mechanistic link from FN1 to lactate production to histone lactylation to KIT activation is well-integrated, though the relative contribution of each step to imatinib resistance warrants quantitative assessment.

hypotheses.hypothesis: FTO-mediated m⁶A demethylation of FN1 mRNA protects it from YTHDF3-mediated degradation
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; reduced m⁶A modification at position 631 prevents YTHDF3 recognition

hypotheses.hypothesis: FN1-driven lactate production elevates H3K18la to activate KIT and promote GIST malignancy
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; elevated FN1 correlates with glycolytic pathway activation and increased H3K18la

title: Gain-of-function suppressors restore microtubule dynamics and rescue dominant-negative tubulinopathies
task: Identify suppressors of dominant-negative tubulin mutations causing tubulinopathies
key_results: Three classes of missense suppressors identified; intergenic suppressors in reciprocal tubulin genes restore MT architecture and rescue pathogenic tubulin-induced defects in human cells and murine oocytes
comments: The work elegantly bridges C. elegans genetics with mammalian systems, though clinical translation requires addressing potential off-target effects of suppressor variants.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Intergenic suppressors restore MT dynamics via competitive exclusion or assembly modulation
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; assembly-defective variants competitively exclude mutant tubulins while assembly-competent variants modulate dynamics

hypotheses.hypothesis: Gain-of-function suppressors restore protofilament geometry
hypotheses.result: Supported by molecular simulations showing geometry restoration

title: Optimized cuvette-based electroporation of buffalo and caprine zygotes supports the delivery of up to 21 kilobase plasmids
task: Optimize electroporation for large DNA construct delivery into livestock zygotes
key_results: Cuvette-based electroporation successfully delivered 1.8–21.0 kbp constructs into buffalo and goat zygotes with blastocyst formation rates comparable to controls; no significant apoptotic gene upregulation; OCT4 and CDX2 significantly upregulated in pGOF18-electroporated embryos
comments: The achievement of efficient large plasmid (21 kbp) delivery without compromising developmental competence addresses a major technical bottleneck, though long-term transgene stability remains to be demonstrated.

model_io.model: Buffalo and caprine zygotes (10 h post-insemination)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Optimized electroporation preserves preimplantation developmental competence for large DNA constructs
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; no significant differences in cleavage or blastocyst formation rates vs. controls

hypotheses.hypothesis: Electroporation induces minimal cellular stress in embryos
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; no significant differences in apoptotic gene (BAX, Caspase-9) expression

title: Icariin prevents acute high-altitude pulmonary edema in rats by alleviating oxidative stress and modulating cuproptosis-related proteins
task: Elucidate mechanisms by which icariin prevents acute high-altitude pulmonary edema
key_results: ICA administration dose-dependently ameliorated AHAPE symptoms (body weight loss, leukocyte elevation, hemoglobin increase, lung damage); increased GSTM5, reduced FDX1, reversed CTR1 redistribution; 89 core differentially expressed proteins identified by proteomics
comments: The multitarget mechanism involving glutathione metabolism, copper homeostasis, and cuproptosis is comprehensive, though causality between individual pathways and AHAPE prevention requires further dissection.

model_io.model: Rat hypobaric hypoxia model (6000 m altitude simulation, 3 days)

inputs: lung tissue from AHAPE and ICA-treated rats

hypotheses.hypothesis: ICA prevents AHAPE by alleviating oxidative stress and restoring mitochondrial function
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; increased GSTM5 and altered FDX1 expression consistent with antioxidant effects

hypotheses.hypothesis: ICA modulates cuproptosis-related pathways to prevent tissue injury
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; reversed CTR1 redistribution and copper accumulation in lung tissue

title: FBL facilitates interstrand DNA crosslink repair by 2’-O-methylating FANCD2 mRNA
task: Determine epitranscriptional regulation of interstrand DNA crosslink repair via FANCD2 mRNA methylation
key_results: FBL mediates 2'-O-methylation at position 2837 in FANCD2 mRNA, extending its half-life and increasing protein expression; FBL downregulated in FA patients; R207S FBL mutation impairs 2'-O-methyltransferase activity in AML/MDS patients
comments: The identification of FBL-dependent epitranscriptional regulation as a novel FA pathway component elegantly explains disease pathology in FA-related hematologic malignancies, though the specific structural basis for R207S impairment deserves clarification.

model_io.model: ICL repair assay in cultured cells
FA patient and AML/MDS tumor analysis

hypotheses.hypothesis: FBL-mediated 2'-O-methylation of FANCD2 mRNA enhances ICL repair
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; FBL promotes ICL repair by extending FANCD2 mRNA half-life via 2837-position methylation

hypotheses.hypothesis: R207S FBL mutation impairs 2'-O-methyltransferase activity in FA-related disorders
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; R207S significantly impairs FBL methyltransferase activity in AML/MDS patients

title: MMSDH facilitates ACSL4 propionylation to counteract ferroptosis upon hypoxia and impairs PDAC chemotherapy efficacy
task: Identify valine catabolism-mediated ferroptosis resistance mechanism in pancreatic cancer chemoresistance
key_results: Hypoxia induces GCN5-mediated lactylation of MMSDH at K113; lactylated MMSDH generates propionyl-CoA facilitating KAT8-mediated ACSL4 K606 propionylation, promoting HSC70-mediated ACSL4 autophagy; MMSDH-K113la correlates with low ACSL4 and poor neoadjuvant chemotherapy response; valine restriction + gemcitabine synergistically induces ferroptosis
comments: The mechanism elegantly connects valine metabolism to post-translational modification cascades controlling ferroptosis; the therapeutic potential of dietary valine restriction is intriguing but requires careful consideration of systemic metabolic effects.

model_io.model: PDAC cells under hypoxia with gemcitabine (GC)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Hypoxia-induced MMSDH lactylation promotes ACSL4 propionylation and degradation, suppressing ferroptosis
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; MMSDH-K113la facilitates ACSL4 K606 propionylation and HSC70-mediated autophagy

hypotheses.hypothesis: Valine restriction + gemcitabine synergistically induce ferroptosis by impairing MMSDH function
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; blocking MMSDH-K113la potentiates GC-induced ferroptosis and suppresses tumor growth

title: RAISE quantifies RNA binding protein activity via transcriptomic profiling
task: Quantify RNA-binding protein activity from splicing patterns
key_results: RAISE accurately inferred RBP activity across multiple cell lines and identified cancer-associated RBP activity alterations in TCGA datasets; constructed RBP–exon regulatory networks integrating CLIP-seq, motifs, and RNA-seq data.
comments: Comprehensive framework addressing a genuine bottleneck in splicing regulation, though activity inference remains indirect and validation in independent cohorts would strengthen claims.

hypotheses.hypothesis: RBP activity can be inferred from multimodal splicing evidence independent of expression levels
hypotheses.result: RAISE captured activity changes decoupled from RBP expression; validated across perturbation experiments

title: Cancer treatment alters mutant selection in normal esophagus
task: Characterize treatment-driven mutant selection in normal esophageal epithelium post-cancer therapy
key_results: CROSS therapy expanded TP53 and PPM1D mutant clones; FLOT regimen selected for RAC1, NFE2L2, MTOR mutations consistent with 5-fluorouracil resilience; treatment-specific mutational signatures identified.
comments: Innovative approach revealing therapy-induced selective pressures on normal epithelium; sample size (n=70) and mechanistic validation limited, but opens new perspective on therapy-associated genomic consequences.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Cancer therapy induces selective expansion of specific mutant clones in morphologically normal epithelium
hypotheses.result: CROSS associated with TP53/PPM1D expansion; FLOT associated with RAC1/NFE2L2/MTOR expansion consistent with drug resilience

title: Scalable assembly of Ascaris mitogenomes from whole-genome data reveals a novel clade
task: Assemble Ascaris mitochondrial genomes from whole-genome data and resolve parasite population diversity
key_results: Bioinformatic framework yielded 149 high-quality Ascaris mitogenome assemblies; identified novel Clade D associated with Ethiopian human samples; refined Clade C to pig-derived European origin; expanded mitochondrial clade diversity.
comments: Scalable mtDNA recovery from low-coverage data provides cost-effective phylogenetic resolution; Clade D discovery highlights undersampled geographic regions, though functional/phenotypic characterization of clades remains limited.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Systematic mtDNA assembly from WGS reveals previously uncharacterized Ascaris population diversity
hypotheses.result: Identified novel Clade D in Ethiopian human samples; refined host/geographic associations for existing clades

title: Investigation of 1H-1,2,3-triazole derivatives as TGF-β pathway targeted therapeutics for oral squamous cell carcinoma: an in-silico approach
task: Identify triazole derivatives as TGF-β inhibitors for oral cancer
key_results: Compounds 3e and 3o exhibited best docking scores of -12.1 kcal/mol; stable binding confirmed via 500 ns molecular dynamics simulations.
comments: Purely computational workflow lacking experimental validation; in silico binding affinity alone does not guarantee cellular efficacy or selectivity.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Triazole derivatives can inhibit TGF-β signaling via stable binding to TGF-βI
hypotheses.result: Compounds 3e and 3o showed favorable docking, non-covalent interactions, and MD stability

title: Evaluating directed and multiplex network representations for prediction of emerging contamination pathways in food safety surveillance
task: Predict emerging food contamination pathways using directed multiplex networks
key_results: Directional modeling improved AUC by 0.023 over undirected treatment (0.804 ± 0.011); ranked pairs identified 2024–2025 pathways with 45% precision at rank 100 vs 9.4% base rate.
comments: Rigorous statistical correction revealed that network topology provides modest improvement; simpler out-degree × in-degree product matches complex GNN performance.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Directed network representation improves contamination pathway prediction over undirected models
hypotheses.result: Directional modeling achieved 0.804 AUC; multiplex and GNN layers added no significant benefit

title: Machine learning-accelerated analysis of in utero embryo phenotyping in C. elegans for reproductive toxicity assessment
task: Automate embryo phenotyping in C. elegans for developmental and reproductive toxicity assessment
key_results: EmbryoMAE-Det achieved mAP 88.7% (early-stage AP 92.8%, late-stage AP 84.7%); reduced analysis time 1,000× to ~20 min per chip; EC50 values statistically indistinguishable from manual scoring with <10.4% technical replicate CV.
comments: Impressive efficiency gains addressing genuine bottleneck; self-supervised pretraining on ~48k embryos demonstrates scalability for whole-organism NAMs, though external validation on diverse chemical space needed.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Masked autoencoder pretraining + supervised detection/classification automates embryo analysis with performance equivalent to manual scoring
hypotheses.result: Model-derived embryo counts and EC50 values statistically indistinguishable from manual; 1,000× speedup achieved

title: Facial video-based non-contact stress recognition: a multi-stage framework utilizing contrastive learning and attention mechanisms
task: Recognize psychological stress from facial videos via contactless physiological sensing
key_results: MS-CAM-Net achieved 99.2% accuracy for binary stress-state recognition and 86.7% for three-class stress classification under fixed subject-independent split; 3.1 and 1.6 percentage point improvements over prior methods.

title: Design, synthesis, in silico docking, and DFT analysis of 1,2,3–triazoles containing quinoxaline hybrids as effective antimicrobial agents
task: Design antimicrobial quinoxaline–triazole hybrids via click chemistry
key_results: Compounds 4c, 4e, 4h, 4j showed potent S. aureus inhibition (33–36 mm zones); compound 4e achieved antitubercular MIC of 2.76 µg/mL, comparable to Streptomycin (3.14 µg/mL).
comments: Solid chemical synthesis with in vitro validation, but docking and ADME-Tox predictions lack independent experimental confirmation of bioavailability.

title: Graph-radiomic learning (GrRAiL) descriptor to characterize imaging heterogeneity in confounding tumor pathologies
task: Characterize intralesional heterogeneity in tumors via graph-radiomic learning
key_results: GrRAiL achieved 89% cross-validation / 78% test accuracy (glioblastoma), 84% / 74% (brain metastasis), 85% / 79% (IPMN); >10% test-accuracy improvements over GNNs and textural radiomics.
comments: Novel spatial graph representation of radiomic features shows consistent gains, but modest improvements on IPMN suggest diminishing returns; clinical utility requires prospective validation.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Graph-theoretic modeling of intralesional radiomic heterogeneity improves distinction of malignancy from confounding pathologies
hypotheses.result: GrRAiL outperformed comparative methods across three use cases; test accuracy gains of 10–13 percentage points

title: Novel lipid-associated loci determine phage-host interaction in Mycobacterium abscessus
task: Identify genetic determinants of phage-host interaction in Mycobacterium abscessus
key_results: Confirmed trehalose polyphleate (TPP) as conserved phage infection determinant; identified novel 10+ gene genomic region and furB/nrnA mutations as determinants in smooth morphotype; phage resistance consistently linked to impaired adsorption and lipid metabolism dysregulation.
comments: Comprehensive integration of genomics, transcriptomics, and functional assays, though causal validation remains challenging in clinical strains; findings suggest druggable metabolic pathways for phage therapy.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Phage resistance in M. abscessus is mediated by alterations in surface-associated lipids and glycolipid composition
hypotheses.result: Novel lipid-metabolism loci and furB/nrnA mutations associated with impaired phage adsorption; transcriptional rewiring of lipid genes confirmed

title: Enhancing saltiness perception through food structure design: multi-scale mechanisms and strategies
task: Review multi-scale mechanisms for saltiness perception enhancement through food structure design
key_results: Elucidates mechanisms from food structure through oral processing to sensory integration; proposes AI and dynamic modeling for low-sodium food design
comments: Review paper focusing on sodium reduction strategy; no primary experimental results or quantitative benchmarks provided.
